name: Semantic Validator
description: Embedding-based semantic similarity validation between input and output text. Optionally uses sentence-transformers library for cosine similarity computation. Gracefully degrades when dependencies are unavailable.

types.name: SemanticValidator

fields.name: _model_name
fields.description: Name of the sentence-transformers model to use

fields.name: _model
fields.description: Loaded model instance, False if import failed, None if not yet loaded

types.description: Embedding-based similarity checker with lazy model loading. Maintains internal state for model name and loaded model instance.

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Initialize the SemanticValidator with a specified sentence-transformers model name. Does not load the model immediately (lazy loading).

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Name of the sentence-transformers model to use

postconditions: _model_name is set to the provided model_name
_model is set to None (not yet loaded)

functions.name: _load
functions.description: Lazy-load the sentence-transformers model. Attempts to import sentence_transformers and instantiate the model. Sets _model to False if ImportError occurs, and logs a warning. Does nothing if model is already loaded.

error_data.handling: Caught and logged; _model set to False

postconditions: _model is SentenceTransformer instance if import succeeds
side_effects: Logs warning if sentence-transformers not installed

structured_side_effects.description: May download model weights if not cached

functions.name: validate
functions.description: Compute cosine similarity between input_text and output_text using sentence embeddings. Returns None if model loading failed. Normalizes embeddings and computes dot product.
postconditions: Returns None if _model is False (dependencies unavailable)
Returns float in range [-1.0, 1.0] representing cosine similarity if model available
Typically returns values in [0.0, 1.0] for normalized embeddings
side_effects: Calls _load() which may trigger model loading

functions.name: is_valid
functions.description: Check if semantic similarity between input and output exceeds a threshold. Returns True if similarity >= threshold, False otherwise, or None if validation unavailable.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Minimum similarity score to consider valid

postconditions: Returns None if validate() returns None
side_effects: Calls validate() which triggers model loading and encoding

invariants: _model is either None (not loaded), False (failed to load), or a SentenceTransformer instance

data_access.rationale: No persistent data access. All operations are in-memory computation with optional model weight caching by sentence-transformers library.

side_effects.rationale: SentenceTransformer may download weights from HuggingFace on first use
